sentiment.rationale: This is a pre-earnings digest, so the guidance-change framework does not apply; instead, the score reflects how stretched market expectations are heading into the print. The document describes a stock trading near yearly highs at elevated valuation multiples (20-22x forward EPS), with analyst estimates having been raised and option markets pricing in a moderately high beat expectation, leaving little room for a soft print. This demanding bar raises the risk of a negative reaction even on decent results, warranting a bearish score.
